name: @pilotspan/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Pilotspan (common + domain YAMLs)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle readiness --output src/.bundled/readiness.json && redocly bundle pilots --output src/.bundled/pilots.json && redocly bundle anonymisation-gates --output src/.bundled/anonymisation-gates.json && redocly bundle custodians --output src/.bundled/custodians.json && redocly bundle talent-assignments --output src/.bundled/talent-assignments.json && redocly bundle shadow-ai --output src/.bundled/shadow-ai.json
